name: Dev Options
author: DecompRecomp
description: Developer options: unlimited Life Points (restores to 8000 if below 6000) and the option to end your turn directly from hand without playing a card.

settings.label: Unlimited Life Points
settings.description: Increases player Life Points to 8000 whenever it drops below 6000.

settings.label: End turn without playing
settings.description: Press Select or R1 during hand phase to end your turn without playing any card.

settings.label: Enter field without playing
settings.description: Press L1 during hand phase to proceed to field phase without playing a card.
